gate_3.name: Architecture Claims Gate
gate_3.summary_sentence: All Model B architectural claims verified: 24-layer parallel hybrid attention/SSM topology confirmed, and all 24 conv1d and 24 out_proj modules enumerated and marked EXCLUDED.

claims.statement: Model B is a 24-layer parallel hybrid model combining self-attention and Mamba-2 SSM branches operating in parallel on the same normalized hidden state and summed before the FFN.

Model B contains exactly 24 conv1d modules (430,080 params) and 24 out_proj modules (150,994,944 params) in the Mamba mixer path; all 48 modules (151,425,024 params) are marked Validity.EXCLUDED under ADR-005.

conv1d.validity_reason: Feeds a custom autograd Mamba kernel that bypasses the LoRA forward pass; adapter is silently inert. Borobia et al. (arXiv:2604.22127) Sec. 3.2 exclude it after observing training instability.
